process_route.name: Blanking
process_route.description: Cut from bar stock, total length 100.0 mm, reserve face allowance.

process_route.name: Face Turning
process_route.description: Turn both faces to establish axial datum.

process_route.name: Center Drilling
process_route.description: Drill center holes at both ends for center clamping.

process_route.name: Rough Turning
process_route.description: Rough turn stepped profile with allowance (rough allowance ~2.0 mm).

process_route.name: Semi-finish Turning
process_route.description: Semi-finish turn segments with finishing allowance (finish allowance ~1.3 mm).

process_route.name: Stabilization / Aging
process_route.description: Stabilization / aging heat treatment to relieve residual stress before finishing (per drawing).

process_route.name: Heat Treatment
process_route.description: Quench and temper to the drawing-specified mechanical properties.

process_route.name: Repair Center Holes
process_route.description: Recover finishing datum after heat treatment.

process_route.name: Finish Turning
process_route.description: Finish turn the full stepped profile to target dimensions, including fillets, chamfers and end tapers.

process_route.name: Straighten
process_route.description: Straighten if distortion exceeds tolerance after machining/heat treatment.

process_route.name: Dynamic Balancing
process_route.description: Dynamic balancing for high-speed / dynamically balanced shafts.

process_route.name: Chamfer & Deburr
process_route.description: Chamfer sharp edges and deburr all machined features (fillets, end bevels, edges) per drawing.

process_route.name: Final Inspection
process_route.description: Check segment dimensions, feature positions, tolerance, roughness and appearance.

process_route.name: Cleaning
process_route.description: Clean part to remove cutting fluid, chips and contaminants.

process_route.name: Packaging
process_route.description: Apply rust preventive oil and package for shipment.

process_route.name: Blanking
process_route.description: Cut from bar stock, total length 100.0 mm, reserve face allowance.

process_route.description: Turn both faces to establish axial datum.

process_route.description: Drill center holes at both ends for center clamping.

process_route.name: Rough Turning
process_route.description: Rough turn stepped profile with allowance (rough allowance ~2.0 mm).

process_route.name: Semi-finish Turning
process_route.description: Semi-finish turn segments with finishing allowance (finish allowance ~1.3 mm).

process_route.name: Stabilization / Aging
process_route.description: Stabilization / aging heat treatment to relieve residual stress before finishing (per drawing).

process_route.name: Heat Treatment
process_route.description: Quench and temper to the drawing-specified mechanical properties.

process_route.name: Repair Center Holes

process_route.name: Finish Turning
process_route.description: Finish turn the full stepped profile to target dimensions, including fillets, chamfers and end tapers.

process_route.name: Straighten
process_route.description: Straighten if distortion exceeds tolerance after machining/heat treatment.

process_route.name: Dynamic Balancing
process_route.description: Dynamic balancing for high-speed / dynamically balanced shafts.

process_route.name: Chamfer & Deburr
process_route.description: Chamfer sharp edges and deburr all machined features (fillets, end bevels, edges) per drawing.

process_route.name: Final Inspection
process_route.description: Check segment dimensions, feature positions, tolerance, roughness and appearance.

process_route.name: Cleaning
process_route.description: Clean part to remove cutting fluid, chips and contaminants.

process_route.name: Packaging
process_route.description: Apply rust preventive oil and package for shipment.

route.description: Semi-finish turn segments with finishing allowance (finish allowance ~1.3 mm).

route.name: Stabilization / Aging
route.description: Stabilization / aging heat treatment to relieve residual stress before finishing (per drawing).

route.name: Heat Treatment
route.description: Quench and temper to the drawing-specified mechanical properties.

route.name: Repair Center Holes
route.description: Recover finishing datum after heat treatment.

route.name: Finish Turning
route.description: Finish turn the full stepped profile to target dimensions, including fillets, chamfers and end tapers.

route.name: Straighten
route.description: Straighten if distortion exceeds tolerance after machining/heat treatment.

route.name: Dynamic Balancing
route.description: Dynamic balancing for high-speed / dynamically balanced shafts.

route.name: Chamfer & Deburr
route.description: Chamfer sharp edges and deburr all machined features (fillets, end bevels, edges) per drawing.

route.name: Final Inspection
route.description: Check segment dimensions, feature positions, tolerance, roughness and appearance.

route.name: Cleaning
route.description: Clean part to remove cutting fluid, chips and contaminants.

route.name: Packaging
route.description: Apply rust preventive oil and package for shipment.
